Quest VROpen this site in Quest Browser and choose Enter VR. Left trigger: hold and release to teleport. Right stick: snap turn. Right grip or A: flashlight. Left grip or X / right B: menu. Point and pull either trigger to select a menu button.
SaveOpen view settings to save a picture or the 3D model.
